summary:
Applied the omarchy "searock" theme, a branded header, and real markdown/ANSI rendering. (1) Theme: replaced the default shadcn oklch palette in app/globals.css with the searock hex tokens (background #200b04, card/popover #180803, well #100602 for code/log blocks, elevated/border/input #36231d, foreground #e6c2ae, muted-foreground #ad9283, primary/accent/ring #b186bb, destructive #cb9a59, chart-1..5 mapped to the palette's green/cyan/blue/magenta/yellow hues), added --color-well/--color-bright-foreground/--color-destructive-foreground to the @theme inline mapping, set --radius to 0.375rem, and made :root === .dark (dark is the only mode). components/theme-provider.tsx now forces next-themes to dark (forcedTheme="dark", enableSystem=false) and drops the light/dark hotkey since there's nothing to toggle to. status-badge.tsx now colors approved/unstable/stable with the chart-3/chart-5/chart-1 tokens (translucent bg + matching text) instead of generic outline/default variants, keeping requested (secondary) and rejected (destructive) as-is. (2) Header: added components/omarchy-logo.tsx, an inline React SVG (fill=currentColor paths copied from public/omarchy-logo.svg) so the wordmark inherits text color; wired it into app/page.tsx next to a 'Package Requests' heading, sized ~22px/28px (mobile/sm+) via className. (3) Markdown: `npm install react-markdown remark-gfm`; added components/markdown.tsx, a themed component-map wrapper (headings in bright-foreground, code/pre on the well token, tables mapped onto the existing shadcn Table primitives for border-token rules) and swapped it in for the raw 
{markdown}
dossier renders in build-section.tsx and build-report-section.tsx. (4) ANSI: `npm install anser`; added lib/ansi.ts exporting escapeHtml() and ansiLogToHtml() (escapes HTML first, then anser.ansiToHtml with use_classes:false), wired into phase-evidence.tsx's 'Raw log' 
 via dangerouslySetInnerHTML on the well-token background. Added lib/ansi.test.ts (6 cases: character escaping, HTML-in-log escaping, ANSI-to-span conversion, HTML escaped inside an ANSI-colored segment, and a plain-text passthrough).
notes: npm test (64 tests, 6 files), npm run typecheck, and npm run build all pass. Also manually smoke-tested with `next dev` + a headless Chromium screenshot pass against real swamp data (testpkg/figlet/etc.): dark theme renders correctly, wordmark+header look right, status badges show distinct chart hues, the evidence-fallback build report renders with themed badges, and an expanded phase's raw build log renders on the well background via the ANSI pipeline with no console errors. The full-dossier Markdown path (source==='report') wasn't exercised live since no currently-retained dossier had non-null markdown in this sandbox's swamp data, but it's a thin, directly-typed wrapper around react-markdown/remark-gfm and passed typecheck/build. Left components/package-request/{approval-queue-tab,lifecycle-strip,promotion-tab,request-details-panel,submit-tab}.tsx untouched — they already carried unrelated uncommitted changes in the working tree before this task started (pre-existing responsive/copy tweaks from an earlier stage), not part of this work item. Badge colors reuse the existing --chart-1/3/5 tokens (already present in the shadcn scaffold) rather than adding new ones, per 'tokens only'. The lifecycle-strip stepper intentionally keeps using --primary for its current/past steps (a progress indicator, not a discrete status label) rather than adopting per-stage chart hues.
